testWhereWithLengthAndCast
cases.src:
define view entity any_view
  as select from dtab

  association to other_dtab as _asso
    on $projection.id = _asso.id

{
  key id,

      _asso.field1
}

where _asso.field1 like    'S%'
  and length( _asso.field1   ) = abap.int1'4'
  and created_on between abap.dats'20200101' and abap.dats'20200401'
  and cast(   _asso.field2 as any_type preserving type ) = abap.char'literal'
cases.exp:
